name: Set Secret
description: Store an encrypted secret in the caller's per-user secret store. The secret value is redacted in the job record. Refuses to replace an existing secret unless overwrite is explicitly true.

name.description: Single secret name (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY), not an s/ path

overwrite.description: Set true to replace an existing secret. Omitted or false protects the existing value.

stored.description: Whether the secret was stored successfully
